title: Ohio woman finds clothes, photos in dumpster amid divorce dispute; ex-husband ordered to pay $2,280
summary_full: During her divorce proceedings, Brenda S. Dilts was shocked to find her belongings tossed aside in a recycling dumpster. Her ex-husband, Phillip R. Dilts, faced contempt charges for breaching court orders about their property division. A court ruled against him, ordering payment of attorney fees, and the appellate court upheld this decision, emphasizing the importance of compliance with divorce agreements.
